hook_text: How many matches for 100 squares in a row? No building allowed.
clip_script: Justify three times the number of squares plus one, using the matchstick picture. Think of each square as having three matches of its own: a top, a bottom and a right-hand side. With n squares that is three times n matches. But the very first square also needs a left-hand side, which no other square provides. So we add one. The hundredth matchstick pattern: three times one hundred plus one, 301 matches.
visual_style: A long row of matchstick squares zooms out to 100; each square's top, bottom and right side glow in one colour and the single first left side in another; a counter lands on 301.
pacing: Hook question, colour-coded explanation, big zoom-out reveal.
